youtube_description:
This week I am featuring 4 great frozen waterfall hikes in Alberta. They are Troll Falls, Grotto Canyon, Heart Creek, and Johnston Canyon. All of these were fairly short and easy hikes.

This is my 28th video.  Thank you very much for watching.  If you enjoyed this video please give it a thumbs up.  If you would like to see my other videos, Subscribe to my channel.  New videos weekly.  CHEERS

Thank you,
